_spec.purpose: The variety engine. No two decks visually alike.
_spec.why: Each run records the techniques, palette, structure and camera it used, and the next run reads this to know what it may not reach for again. Without it a machine converges on whatever worked once, which is how a daily product develops a house style nobody chose.
_spec.enforced_by: scripts/carousel/bespoke_check.py measures WITHIN a deck. This ledger constrains ACROSS decks. Both are needed: a deck can be nine different drawings that all look like last Tuesday.

entries.register: dark, Big Bend at dusk, with one deliberate paper inversion at slide 5
techniques: extruded county with a true scale overlay
parallax planes with a two part contact shadow
engraving, white line intaglio
the residual bar at true ratio
stipple tooth on a paper register with a torn deckle
arrested flow field with a norther front stop
hachured soil section over layered horizons
Big Bend dusk field with one dust column

palette.bluestem: #C9A063 little bluestem seed head in August

entries.red_note: No comment window on this story closes in a period a reader can act on, so the reserved red stayed unspent.
entries.camera: one county at close range, then an object stack, then flat type, then two masses, then a sheet, then a field with a hard stop, then a section below grade, then the dusk horizon
entries.bespoke_closest_pair: After the cut, the closest pair no longer involves cartography. bespoke_median 0.3997 was measured on the nine slide deck; the shipped deck is eight and the pair that produced 0.8859 is the frame that was cut.
entries.cut: Slide 2, the state locator, cut after the third scoring pass. Three independent reviews called it the most cuttable frame, it was the closest visual pair, and its only unique content was a county land area.

entries.register: daylight throughout, a Gulf Coast overcast working sheet, with exactly one dark interior at slide 7
techniques: SDF raymarch, a 16 by 9 recess carved into a brick mass
single-county spotlight with a leader line to a label outside the mesh
grid decay threshold-driven from an fBm field
line and node as engineering stationing over a heat shimmer band
relit tiles at true duration, rotated and overlapping, on no shared baseline
heightfield terrain with a horizon solved from the projection centre
a lit panel in a shadowed interior with a plate measured for a line the record does not contain
axonometric plaques, one pairing per row, widths following the names
line and node with an unfilled ring, over an oil-chart field table

palette.source: a post-war Houston ISD elementary building on the Gulf Coast prairie, Harris County
palette.overcast: #E9EAE6 the flat August lid over Houston

structural_laws: no circles anywhere except one path node, argued for by name
filled means the source states it, outlined means the source calls it optional or does not describe it

entries.register: night inside a public building, no horizon on any frame, lit only from behind glass and off brass, with one bright paper sheet at slide 5
techniques: an August month sheet embossed into limestone with one cell cut clean through, lit by a raking key that finds no floor
a constant-rate day rule with two bars sharing one origin, above and below
a true space-filling Voronoi partition, every cell identical and unassigned, inside a hard neatline
a mid century oil chart table under a low lamp, tabular mono, three quoted figures from two documents
a flat neatlined survey sheet on the paper register, two equal quoted columns
four equal terrazzo inlay bands seen straight down
a redaction field of struck bars with the one entry nobody inked left hollow and ruled
a lit cell over a dated list of what is still open, the opening void inverted

palette.source: the Texas county courthouse at night, which every county has, so a statewide story takes a statewide material rather than one place's soil
palette.tower: #16151C masonry in shadow, warm neutral with no violet so it is not the house Big Bend night
palette.dial: #EFE9DA enameled cast iron lit from behind, the deck's light
palette.pecos: #8E4B3A masonry red, fill only, slide 6 band only

structural_laws: no horizon anywhere, because the story has no place
one day is 46 pixels on every frame that draws time, and no axis is truncated
ruled means quoted, a hairline above and below with attribution and claim id beneath
no cartography at all, the first deck here with none
entries.camera: one tilted sheet, then a flat rule, then straight down on a field, then a lit table, then a flat sheet, then straight down on a floor, then a block on stone, then one lit cell
entries.cut: Slide 4, whose water and whose power, was cut after scoring. Its headline promised power and the frame delivered only water, and it sat before the deck's densest frame. The freed frame went to the close, which had no way for a reader to act.
entries.renumbered_after_the_cut: Recorded at the third scoring pass. The register, three palette notes and the camera line were all written against the nine slide plan and survived the cut of slide 4 unchanged, so this entry named the wrong frame for the paper inversion, for both accent fills and in every camera move after the fourth. Nothing checked it, because the variety ledgers are written at ship and no gate reads them back against the deck.
entries.bespoke_measurement_note: 0.5314 was measured while bespoke_check was still counting the standing masthead, which this run put on every frame. On the closest pair it shared 50 tokens and exactly one was a drawing call. The gate now strips anything carrying a tx- class, and the two decks that never carried one move only 0.3997 to 0.4061 and 0.2298 to 0.2300.
